_doc: The sheriff on the road (docs/missions/the-sheriff.md; issue #746, the first mission, rough). Dawn at Harlan's homestead; he walks the ford path down to the East Road and finds the sheriff gut-shot at opening_site, his horse standing off the road with its reins down. Nod to help him, shake your head to leave him (the view's nod and shake, HeadGesture). Hold E on the wound to press it, long enough and it's packed and bound. E by his horse: the stand-in card (leading a horse isn't built), the walk into town run on his body (Physiology), the doctor at his greybox. sheriff.care = good (packed, and his blood loss at the doctor's at most care.good_max_loss) / poor (taken in otherwise) / left him (you walked off). Started in the valley by -- --world=valley --mission=sheriff, or the bridge's `moment the_sheriff`; Enter afterwards (or held 1.5 s any time) starts it again. Lines are typed, chosen by his blood loss (Act: bands).

wound._doc: Gut-shot two game hours before dawn (shot_ago_s, real seconds: 112.5 a game hour): what he's lost lying there, a weeping wound in the belly wall (outer: shows, pressed and packed by you; it doesn't clot on its own) and a slow bleed inside (inner: nothing outside reaches it). Each stops by its limit (ml), so untreated and left he passes out (0.42 lost) but doesn't bleed to death on the road: by the wound rules a gut shot has hours (Physiology's gut_death_game_hours does for him later).

care._doc: good: you packed it (pressed pack_s in all) and he'd lost no more than good_max_loss of his blood by the doctor's; poor: you took him in otherwise; left him: you walked off (found_m, then leave_m from him before he's on the horse).

trip._doc: The stand-in for leading his horse into town (Sean's maybe, #746: no horse of Harlan's at the start): the road's length from the site to the doctor (ValleyRoads), walked at lead_mps, plus load_s getting him up across the saddle; the minutes run on his body and the clock.

cards.trip:
You get him up across his saddle and lead his horse down the East Road into town.
(%d minutes on foot. A stand-in: leading a horse isn't built yet.)
cards.left:
You leave him on the road.
Later that morning a freighter coming down the East Road finds him and hauls him into town in the back of his wagon.
cards.end:
The doctor takes him in. His horse is put up at the livery.

sheriff.care: %s

(Enter: start again)

clear: Keep your hands where I can see 'em.
weak: Who's there? Don't... don't come closer.

clear: Harlan. You're Harlan, from up the creek. I'm gut-shot. I need the doc. You going to help me or not?
weak: I'm shot. In the belly. Get me to the doc... will you?
fading: Doc... get me to the doc.

clear: Well? Nod or don't, but don't just stand there.
Thank God. Press on it. Hard. It won't quit bleeding.
Man in a faded red shirt. Rode up easy, like he wanted directions. Then he shot me.
weak: Red shirt. Faded red. Rode up like a friend.

clear: You'd leave a man in the road? Then go on. Damn you.
Christ! That's it. Keep on it.
That'll hold. My horse is yonder. Get me up on him.
Sun's coming up. Ain't that something.
Don't you let me lie here.
Gut-shot. Help me get him up the steps.
weak: He's bled a fair bit. Up the steps with him, quick now.
fading: Lord. He's near bled white. Get him inside.
out: He's out cold. Help me with him. Now.

good: Somebody packed that wound, and packed it right. That's bought him some hours. Come back tonight.
poor: He's lost more than he can spare. I'll do what I can. It may not be much.
